headline: 🔥 THE SHOWING FEED BROUGHT NOTHING NEW ALL MORNING — still not one future tour booked anywhere and nothing scheduled since Saturday afternoon, a fourth full day — BUT THE BEST BUYER SIGNAL OF THE WEEK ARRIVED BY TEXT INSTEAD: at 12:11 PM the buyer on 2368 Ridge Trail named his gap under the ask and asked you to represent him, on the one listing two agents have already called too high. That call, Amy G. at 355 Comanche on day six with her basement-lights question still unanswered, and the “VERY interested” buyer ten days cold at 821 Martinwood are the whole afternoon.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 NOT A SHOWINGTIME FORM — THE BUYER HIMSELF, BY TEXT, AT 12:11 PM. Adin D. wrote that he is a defined distance below the ask, told you to save his number as an investor, and added “Happy to have you represent me!” That is a named price gap plus an unprompted representation ask from the only live buyer with a person attached anywhere on this listing — and it lands on the one address where two independent agent reads have already come back TOO HIGH.
hotSignals.action: ☎️ CALL HIM, DO NOT TEXT BACK. Your 11:37 AM reply pointed him at the house and never answered the only question he asked, which was whether there is room — so the thread is open with the substance missing. Two jobs in one call: give him a real answer on room (the seller here is institutional, so the answer is a process, not a feeling), and take the buyer-side relationship he just offered you. ✅ Already on your list as an urgent chip and already flagged in the 12:15 digest — recorded here to prevent a duplicate alert email, none sent.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 AMY G. OF ETHOS INTERNATIONAL filed Saturday at 11:24 PM off that afternoon's 1:00 PM tour: interested — YES, buyers have just started looking, really like the property, and have put it at the TOP OF THEIR LIST. She left both price fields blank, which on this listing is now the fifth consecutive read that declined to argue the number.
hotSignals.action: ☎️ CALL HER — day six, and this is a returned call rather than a cold approach: she is the same agent who phoned from inside the house mid-showing. Two things to carry: answer the basement-lights question she raised in the same form, and ask directly where the house sits against whatever else her buyers are touring this week. ⛔ Call rather than write — the co-op mail lane is a deliberate hold, day twelve unruled.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 AMBER G. OF KELLER WILLIAMS HOOVER: interested — YES, priced right — JUST RIGHT, staging five of five. This remains the single strongest pricing evidence anywhere in the book and the cleanest confirmation that the 8/5 cut did its job.
hotSignals.action: ☎️ Eight days out, so treat this as a status check rather than a fresh lead — are her buyers still live, and did anything specific push them elsewhere? ⭐ Her form is also the receipt to quote to the seller the next time price comes up: do not reopen the number.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 WANDA W. OF MILLENNIUM HOMES answered the interest question with the single word “Very” and rated the experience at the top. Two other agents toured within seventy minutes of her and both passed — so the interest here is one clear voice, not a crowd.
hotSignals.action: 🔴 TEN DAYS UNWORKED AND THIS IS THE CHEAPEST CONTRACT ON THE WHOLE BOARD. At $184K a very-interested buyer is a two-week close, not a six-week one. ☎️ One call: are they still looking, and what would it take? Nothing on this board has a better effort-to-outcome ratio.

upcoming: ⏰ THU 8/20, 3:00 PM — 5167 LAKE CREST CIR closes at the closing attorney's office. Not a ShowingTime event, but it is the nearest hard date on the board and the largest number closing this month. 🔴 CHANGED AT MIDDAY: the closing attorney wrote at 12:39 PM that the buyer's figures changed — one line, no detail, twenty-seven hours out — and a sixth independent search this morning still found no clear-to-close on any lane. The city inspector's sign-off also still sits on closing morning itself.
📅 SAT 8/30 — 833 MADISON LN goes live. Nothing is booked on it because it is not on the market yet.

📤 OVERDUE RATHER THAN UPCOMING — 225 WILLOW POINT was promised a same-day launch at 2:40 PM on 8/18 and still has not gone live a full day later. ⚠️ And the reason may not be the listing entry: your coordinator's note thirteen minutes EARLIER that afternoon said the seller was unsure about activating before their financing. Two people gave two different answers thirteen minutes apart and neither has answered the other since. Until that is settled there is nothing for ShowingTime to book.

📭 NO SHOWINGS BOOKED ANYWHERE, AND NOTHING NEW HAS BEEN SCHEDULED SINCE SATURDAY AFTERNOON — a fourth full day. There is not one future showing, walk-through, inspection or appraisal confirmed on any listing, and the whole morning added zero events to this feed. ⭐ Read it honestly: a silent feed in mid-August across seven actives is a supply problem at the top, not a bad week — and it is exactly why the one buyer who DID reach out today, on a channel this board does not even watch, is the most valuable thing on the page.
